About the job
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is a leader in no-code network automation for hybrid
multi-cloud networks.

What We Need
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of
customer support and software development.

What You'll Do
Own end-to-end resolution of complex customer issues through deep technical
investigation, root cause analysis, and validation of fixes. Act as liaison
between customers, support, engineering, and product teams and ensure
stakeholder alignment. Translate customer issues into well-defined feature
requests and product improvement recommendations. Influence roadmap priorities,
product stability, and customer experience.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable web-based SaaS applications across the
full stack, from system architecture and data design to implementation, testing,
and performance optimization. Meet scalability, reliability, and usability
standards in a multi-tenant SaaS environment. Research, evaluate, and apply new
and emerging technologies. Serve as a subject matter expert and provide
technical mentoring. Participate in an on-call rotation.

What You Bring
Computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms,
multithreading, and system-level concepts (memory, storage, file systems).
Experience developing and supporting enterprise-scale applications,
object-oriented design, and modern architectural patterns such as
Domain-Driven Design. Deep expertise in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and modern
backend architecture. Experience with EF Core, PostgreSQL, query optimization,
AWS RDS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, and CloudWatch. Troubleshoot production issues,
perform root cause analysis, and optimize system performance. Use AI-assisted
development tools such as GitHub Copilot. Strong communication, independent
work, and cross-functional collaboration.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation, benefits, and RRSP matching.
